args.query: installment plan policy max duration parts

results.text: An installment plan is allowed only when the outstanding amount is above INR 20,000. The outstanding amount is the invoice amount minus the amount already paid. A plan has at most 3 parts, the parts must add up exactly to the outstanding amount, and the last part must fall within 60 days of the call. If the outstanding amount is INR 20,000 or less, ask for full payment on a specific date instead. Log the agreed plan with the dates and amounts of every part.

A promise to pay the full amount must be for a date within 30 days of the call. If the debtor cannot pay in full within 30 days, offer an installment plan when the debtor is eligible under the Installment Rules. If not eligible, ask for the earliest date within 30 days and log it.
